name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
des: The Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students is a government scholarship scheme by the VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra. It provides financial assistance to Other Backward Class (OBC) students pursuing higher education after Class 10 (from Class 11 onwards). The scheme covers tuition fees, examination fees, and monthly maintenance allowance for both professional and non-professional courses. Benefits are disbursed directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). As per GR dated 8 July 2024, OBC girl students receive 100% scholarship benefits across all institution types.
benefits: 100% Tuition Fee reimbursement for government/government-aided institution students (professional & non-professional courses)
50% Tuition Fee reimbursement for students in unaided private colleges in professional courses
Examination Fee reimbursement as per actuals
Monthly Maintenance Allowance — Group A courses: Hostlers ₹425/month, Day Scholars ₹190/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance — Group B & C courses: Hostlers ₹290/month, Day Scholars ₹190/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance — Group D courses: Hostlers ₹230/month, Day Scholars ₹190/month
100% benefits (Tuition Fee + Exam Fee + Maintenance Allowance) for B.Ed and D.Ed courses
OBC girl students get 100% scholarship benefits in professional courses at all institution types (GR dated 8 July 2024)
Maintenance allowance paid from date of admission till date of final examination
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
criteria: Student must belong to OBC category as per Central/State OBC list
Student must be a permanent resident/domicile of Maharashtra
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,50,000 (₹1.5 Lakh) from all sources
Student must be studying in a government-recognized institution from Class 11 or above (post-matric level)
For professional courses: admission must be through CAP (Centralized Admission Process) round
Only 2 male children from the same parents are eligible; no restriction on number of female children
If student fails in a year, benefits are given for that year only; suspended until promotion to next class
Student must not be receiving any other major scholarship or stipend simultaneously
Changing course mid-academic year after availing scholarship makes student ineligible for the new course
required_documents: OBC Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (family income ≤ ₹1.5 Lakh)
Admission Receipt / Fee Receipt for current academic year
Previous Year Marksheet (SSC, HSC, or last qualifying examination)
CAP Allotment Letter (mandatory for professional course applicants only)
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal and academic details
Navigate to VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department schemes list
Select 'Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students' and click Apply
Fill in academic details, institute name, course, and admission details
Upload all required documents in specified format (JPG/PDF)
Review all details carefully and submit the application
Note down the Application ID for future status tracking
Track real-time application status using Granular Application Tracking on MahaDBT portal
